name: Revelata deepKPI
description:
Revelata deepKPI gives Claude grounded access to KPIs extracted from SEC filings for US public companies, with up to 10 years of history, updated daily.

All data can be audited with 1-click to see the exact line that the metric was pulled from. Includes access to filing text in markdown, detailed company summaries, and segment breakdowns. 

Built for equity research, diligence, and agent workflows that need trustworthy, citeable financial context.

Key features:
• Semantic KPI search — find time series (revenue, margins, segment metrics, and more) by natural-language query, with values linked back to source excerpts
• KPI catalog — list available metrics for a company before searching to understand how the companies structures their data
• Company summaries & segments — business overview and operating structure from the latest annual filing 
• Filing markdown — list and fetch full filing text for exact quotes and primary-source research

_published_faq.name: How do I add Revelata deepKPI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Revelata deepKPI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://deepkpi-mcp.revelata.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Revelata deepKPI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Revelata deepKPI provides these MCP tools: company_summary_search, get_company_segments, get_company_summary, get_sec_filing_markdown, get_sec_markdown, list_kpis, list_sec_filing_markdowns, list_sec_markdowns, query_company_id, and search_kpis.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Revelata deepKPI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Revelata deepKPI in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Revelata deepKPI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Revelata deepKPI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Revelata deepKPI is developed by Revelata, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
